topic: The Mystery of Pi: Definition and History

sections.title: Hook: The Universal Constant
lecture_lines: Circles are everywhere in our universe.
From small wheels to massive planets.
They all share a secret ratio.

sections.title: Definition: The Ratio of Circumference to Diameter
lecture_lines: It is circumference divided by diameter.
It is the same for every circle.
animations: Draw text 'C/d = Pi' in light blue (#00BFFF).

sections.title: Historical Evolution: From Estimation to Precision
lecture_lines: Archimedes used polygons to refine it.

sections.title: The Nature of Pi: Irrationality
lecture_lines: Its digits never end or repeat.
It cannot be a simple fraction.

sections.title: Summary & Real-World Application
lecture_lines: It is essential for modern space travel.
